about: Layer manifest for the outline master records. One entry per agency layer: its URL, the areas it covers, and the EXPECTED COUNT = the total the layer itself reported (returnCountOnly=true) on 2026-11-10 when a live read was allowed. A short read never changes it. Layers that could not be counted under the host and robots rules have no expected_count. caches = official expected totals for the saved state copies the key builders read (US-FL, ...): taken from the live key file counts.padus (US-FL is 21993 from the restored file, not the 5198 index row left by US-42797939226). CA-ALL is left without a count: the saved copy is a merge of many layers and CPCAD's host disallows this user-agent in robots.txt, so no single official total was taken.
